title: Qwen reasoning joins the text models
summary:
Qwen reasoning and a vision-capable Mistral joined the text lineup, alongside a cache for repeat text requests.

Added `qwen-reasoning` (Qwen QWQ 32B) through Groq and switched `mistral` to the vision-capable Mistral Small 3.1 2503. Mistral-based personas use the new handler too.

Added a Cloudflare Worker that checks R2 for cached text responses before sending misses to the origin. It handles GET and JSON POST requests, while `/models`, `/feed`, and `no-cache` requests bypass the cache.

Added an API docs example that sends a base64-encoded WAV file to `openai-audio` and prints the transcription.

highlights.title: Qwen reasoning added
highlights.text: Try Qwen QWQ 32B through the `qwen-reasoning` text model. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-reasoning).

highlights.title: Mistral gains vision
highlights.text: The `mistral` model now uses vision-capable Mistral Small 3.1 2503, so you can use it with image inputs. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral).
